summary.en: A page writes itself: its blocks are uncovered left to right two at a time, an accent nib riding the front of the newest one.
summary.zh: 一页文档自己“写”出来：内容块两个一组按节拍从左到右揭开，强调色笔尖骑在最新一块的揭示前沿上。

fits: The first appearance of a document, report or dashboard page, the densest page of a film, uncovered in reading order at the pace it can be read.
notFor: A page already seen; pages with little text (it reads as a slow wipe) or blocks not in reading order; real screenshots shown as evidence (uncover them whole).

intent.en: A static page becomes a document being written, so the viewer reads along at the pace it appears and believes the document is real.
intent.zh: 静态页面变成“正在被写出来的文档”，观众跟着出现的速度读下去，并相信这份文档是真的。

content.en: One full page (a document, report or dashboard) with 4–20 blocks in reading order; real, publication-grade copy.
content.zh: 一整页（文档、报告或仪表盘），4–20 个按阅读顺序排列的内容块；文字要真实、达到发布水准。

fits.zh: 文档、报告或仪表盘页面第一次出现，是片中信息最密的一页，按阅读顺序、以读得过来的速度揭开。

notFor.zh: 已经看过的页面；字很少的页面（读成慢速擦除）或块不按阅读顺序的页面；作为证据的真截图（整张亮出）。

pairs.note: the camera pulls back from a tilted close-up while the page writes

en: The page must look published: native layout, filled with text; a token page with a slogan sinks the shot.
No real customer or member names in the mock content.
One nib at a time; two writing fronts split the eye.
zh: 页面要像发布过的：产品原生排版、文字铺满；敷衍的“贴图加标语”页会让整镜重做。
示意内容里绝不出现客户或成员的真名。
同一时间只有一个笔尖，两处同时写会分散视线。

upstream.name: 文档打字揭示
upstream.summary: 悬浮在暗场里的整页真排版文档窗口在光标后自己"写"出来、侧栏跟进、历史条目逐个落入轨道，相机从斜侧标题特写一路后撤到全窗
upstream.use: 文档/报告/笔记类功能镜头；信息密度最高的一拍
upstream.energy: 低中（信息密度最高，节奏放稳让观众读字）

overlaps.note: type-retype types one line character by character; write-on uncovers a whole page block by block
the upstream camera pull-back from a tilted close-up is tilt-camera or viewport-push run over this brick
a title entering; write-on is for a whole page of blocks
